scope: Arithmetic and cluster-setting validation in HackScsd_Mount, src/hack_scsd.c
finding: Partition-loaded FAT sectors bypassed the initial power-of-two cluster check. exFAT cluster shifts and partition-relative additions were unchecked; FAT area multiplication/addition could wrap before root/data addressing.
change: Validate FAT cluster size, nonzero FAT count/reserved area, FAT16 root allocation and minimum FAT32/exFAT root cluster. Enforce the exFAT 32 MiB cluster limit for 512-byte sectors. Check additions and multiplication against u32 capacity before publishing root/data addresses.
verification: check_scsd_mount_geometry.py: all 256 cluster-setting bytes, three formats and direct/partition boot paths (1536 cases)
Independent 64-bit oracle checks 3072 partition/area/count/root/reserved arithmetic boundaries and resulting accepted filesystem fields
Zero FAT16 root allocation and both boot-sector read failures rejected
Baseline 49038c3 fails the same fixture; current source passes
Existing FAT directory and file-read-bound fixtures pass; GNU ARM compilation passes without diagnostics
limitations: Controlled boot sectors and SD reads. This validates selected arithmetic/invariants, not full filesystem conformance. Volume lengths, device capacity, region ordering/overlap, maximum root/chain cluster ranges, boot checksums/signatures and physical hardware remain unverified.
